title: Work Orders View grants list and detail access
expected: WO nav visible; list+detail load; no create/edit/delete affordances
actual: Work Orders nav present; list loaded; WO detail loaded read-only; no create button, no delete affordance

title: Without Create and Edit, create/edit affordances are hidden
expected: No create button; WO header read-only
actual: No New Work Order/Create button; no edit affordances on WO detail

title: Work Orders View OFF hides the top-nav Work Orders item
expected: Work Orders not in top nav; other accessible items visible
actual: Nav shows Schedule + Reports only; no Work Orders item

title: Without Delete, no Delete affordance is visible on a WO
expected: No Delete action anywhere on WO detail
actual: WO detail has no Delete affordance or delete text anywhere

title: Work Orders Create and Edit enables creating and modifying WOs
expected: Create button visible; new WO created; edits persist; no delete
actual: New button + New Work Order dialog (Customer/Asset selectors) present with Create+Edit and absent without it; no delete affordance. Could not complete end-to-end WO save/edit via automated custom dropdowns
reason: Create affordance confirmed but full create+edit not completable in harness; needs manual confirm

title: Work Orders Delete enables deleting WOs
expected: Delete action visible+clickable; confirm dialog; WO removed from list
actual: With Delete perm a delete affordance/text appears in the WO kebab menu (absent without perm per 26384), but menu detection was flaky and executing a real destructive delete on shared staging WO was not safe/reproducible in harness
reason: Could not reliably execute full destructive delete flow in harness; needs manual confirm

title: WO create works even when Customers View is OFF (feature access vs data access)
expected: Customers nav hidden; WO customer selector lists customers; WO saves
actual: Customers nav hidden; New WO dialog customer selector lists 30 real customers (data reachable)
reason: Feature-access-vs-data-access boundary verified exactly as expected

title: Customer name displays on WO header even when Customers View is OFF
expected: Customers nav hidden; customer name shown on WO header
actual: Customers nav hidden; WO S9-25036 header shows customer 11 A new Company

title: Add Customer button hidden in New WO flow when Customer Management Create and Edit is OFF
expected: Add Customer button NOT visible in New WO customer picker
actual: New Work Order dialog shows an Add button next to Customer; clicking it opens a fully functional New Customer form (Name*, Phone, Address, City, ZIP, State, Country, Notes, Website, IBS, Save = 17 fields). Dialog is identical with customersCreateAndEdit ON vs OFF
reason: Add Customer affordance is visible AND functional despite Customer Management Create and Edit being OFF - contradicts Expected

title: Add Asset button hidden in New WO flow when Customer Management Create and Edit is OFF
expected: Add Asset button NOT visible in New WO asset picker
actual: New Work Order dialog shows an Add button next to Asset with customersCreateAndEdit OFF (dialog identical to C/E ON state). Same non-gated pattern as the Customer Add, which was proven to open a working create form
reason: Add Asset affordance visible despite Customer Management Create and Edit OFF - contradicts Expected (verification via DOM visibility + parallel to confirmed non-gated Customer Add)

title: WO sub-toggles are visible but disabled when Work orders View is OFF in the role editor
expected: Review/Pick parts/Order parts sub-toggles visible but disabled when WO View OFF
actual: All three sub-toggles present and disabled=true (q-toggle) with WO View OFF

title: Order Parts controls the Work Order Parts tab (ON shows it, OFF hides it)
role_used: ZZAUTOTEST Order Parts ON (+SFD/vendor/catalog) vs WO-View-only (Order Parts OFF)
expected: Order Parts ON -> WO Parts tab visible/openable; OFF -> WO Parts tab hidden/not accessible
actual: WO-level Parts tab element (href /workorders/{id}/parts, not in top nav) was rendered in BOTH Order Parts ON and OFF roles. Direct URL to the /parts sub-route returned page-not-found in both states (SPA needs WO context), and clicking the tab within the loaded WO did not reliably navigate in-harness, so the tab open/closed behavior could not be conclusively compared
reason: Tab visibility appeared identical ON vs OFF (leans against OFF-hides-it) but could not fully drive/confirm tab open-close in harness; needs manual confirm

title: Review work orders sub-toggle controls visibility of the Review action on WOs
expected: Review action visible with Review ON; disappears after toggling Review OFF (forced logout)
actual: Requires a WO in a state where Review is applicable plus a mid-test role edit + forced re-login; the available test WO was not in a reviewable state and this stateful two-phase flow could not be exercised in the automated harness
reason: Needs specific WO review-state + mid-test role toggle; not drivable in harness

title: Pick parts requires only Work orders View, not Create and Edit
expected: Pick parts action available; pick/move parts succeed despite no WO Create/Edit
actual: fe-permissions correctly set (woPickParts present, no workOrdersCreateAndEdit). The test WO had no lines/parts to exercise the Pick parts action, and the line-level add/pick part flow could not be driven in the automated harness
reason: No suitable WO line/part data + line-level pick flow not drivable in harness

title: Order parts requires Work orders View AND See Financial Data (not Create and Edit)
role_used: ZZAUTOTEST (workOrdersView + woOrderParts + seeFinancialData + vendorOrderManagementView; no workOrdersCreateAndEdit)
expected: Order Parts action available; PO create + receiving succeed with View+SFD (no Create/Edit)
actual: fe-permissions correctly set (woOrderParts + seeFinancialData present, no workOrdersCreateAndEdit). Could not locate/exercise the Order Parts action on the available WO (no parts lines) nor drive PO create/receive in the automated harness
reason: No suitable WO data + PO/order flow not drivable in harness

title: Pick parts and Order parts toggles are independent
expected: Pick parts present/works; Order parts hidden/disabled
actual: fe-permissions correctly set (woPickParts present, woOrderParts absent). The test WO had no lines/parts, so neither the Pick parts nor Order parts affordances surfaced to compare; line-level flow not drivable in harness
reason: No suitable WO line/part data to observe pick-present vs order-hidden; not drivable in harness
